definition: The fictional game setting in which the Standard 5E core book places wizards and their allies.
cultural_caution: A fantasy roleplaying setting that blends history and fantasy; it is not a source for real medieval European, religious, legal, or cultural history.

citations.locator: Official Standard Edition product page, opening description
supports: Mythic Europe as the selected Standard 5E setting context.

definition: The wizard role identified by the Standard 5E core product and labeled on the official character sheet.
cultural_caution: A fictional tabletop role, not a real historical occupation, a claim about real practitioners, or a named character endpoint.

citations.locator: Official Standard Edition product page, opening description
supports: Magi as player wizards in the selected core game.

citations.locator: Official Fifth Edition Character Sheet, header
supports: Magus as the character-sheet role label.

definition: The shared group/community structure in which the core product describes magi gathering with allies and servants; it is also a character-sheet field.
cultural_caution: A fictional game-community and record field, not a collective character endpoint, a real legal/religious covenant, or evidence of a particular character’s membership.

citations.locator: Official Standard Edition product page, opening description
supports: Covenants as the core game’s shared magus setting structure.

citations.locator: Official Fifth Edition Character Sheet, header ‘Covenant’ field
supports: Covenant as a selected Fifth Edition character-record field.

definition: The Standard 5E core product’s play structure in which each player has a magus, a companion, and shares grogs within a saga.
cultural_caution: A tabletop play structure, not an in-world social class or a claim that every saga must use the same character rotation.

citations.locator: Official Standard Edition product page, description bullet on troupe-style roleplaying
supports: Troupe-style roleplaying and its magus/companion/grog structure.

definition: The Standard 5E core magic-system category, recorded as ‘Magical Arts’ on the official character sheet and described as divided into Techniques and Forms.
cultural_caution: A source-specific tabletop magic structure, not a real occult system, a character endpoint, or a general equivalence claim for other fantasy magic rules.

citations.locator: Official Standard Edition product page, magic-system description
supports: Arts as the Standard 5E magic-system structure.

citations.locator: Official Fifth Edition Character Sheet, ‘Magical Arts’ section
supports: Magical Arts as the core-sheet label.

definition: The verb-and-noun components that the Standard 5E product says players combine to represent spell effects.
cultural_caution: A game-mechanical grammar for a fictional magic system, not a real ritual practice, a complete spell list, or a named character endpoint.

citations.locator: Official Standard Edition product page, magic-system description
supports: Techniques and Forms as the Arts’ verb-and-noun components.
